note: The wouterwall kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). The host's ground layers (47-host-land.js): ground.steppe (the feather-grass steppe, the base, tinted by season), ground.needles (the larch's litter on the shaded slopes), ground.gravel (ground.gravel019: the gully floor, the brook's bed), rock.loess (the loess walls, the terraces' risers and the earth pillars, read from the side on the steep: KGROUND's triplanar sides), ground.terrace (ground.terrace.field: the terraced fields, furrows along the contour), ground.tundra and ground.lichen (ground.lichen.crust: the upper bench). The flora at W1 is the NW outer wall's, read in place with its own pack (build.py). Still to wire (PLAN.md section 8): rock.megabreccia (the slump scarps, station 2), rock.rubble.sturzstrom (station 3), card.puya (W3). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/wouterwall after any change, then python3 build.py.
